name: Tim Dooley Atlas Backend Registry
purpose: Machine-readable registry for the canonical atlas data layer. The atlas-manifest is the human-facing map; this registry is the health and endpoint layer beneath it.
policy: Relationship-first. Architecture, records, research evidence, country data and lore remain separate internally but are addressable through one atlas.

countryLayer.remainingResearchQueue: open — macroeconomic country observations must be loaded and validated before a country counts as empirically enriched
countryLayer.status: Overlay existence is no longer treated as evidence. Only validated observations with provenance count toward empirical enrichment.

evidenceLayer.status: Active; global religion observations are loaded with provenance, while country macro indicators remain explicitly researched_missing until cached observations are validated.

graphLayer.status: Evidence-derived edges are kept separate from project-defined symbolic relationships and can be traced to observation IDs.
